title: Review a drawing
description: Mark up a drawing, track the comments and export a review sheet.

steps.title: Markup circle
steps.text: Choose the Markup circle tool (or type MKC in the command line). Click the centre of the item, then click again to set the radius.

steps.title: Add a comment
steps.text: When the Markup comment box opens, type a short comment and confirm. A markup with no comment is not added.

steps.title: The Markups panel
steps.text: Every markup is listed here with its number, comment and status. Click one to find it in the drawing.

steps.title: Filter by status
steps.text: Use the status list at the top of the panel to show All, Open, In progress or Closed markups.

steps.title: Export to CRS
steps.text: Click Export to CRS (xlsx)… to save the markups as a Comment Review Sheet in Excel.

steps.title: Compare drawings
steps.text: To see what changed between two revisions, open the File menu and choose Compare…, then pick the two drawings.
